messages:
dan: seeing a weird pattern: spot nodes in eu-central are getting filled with tiny monitoring and sidecar pods. large inference gangs later can't binpack and get evicted. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/fleet/pack-heatmap
sophia: is this the autoscaler change we rolled yesterday? we adjusted `scale_to_zero_threshold` to more aggressively consolidate.
odar: (that's omar) the consolidation logic had a bug where small pods with `schedulingClass: best-effort` were marked as "high-fit" for GPU racks if they had the `rack-locality: prefer` annotation. that annotation propagated from a chart default.
dan: exact symptom: tiny heartbeat/watchdog containers occupy gpu-node shards, then gang jobs request contiguous NVLink topology -> scheduler can't find contiguous hosts -> preempt -> chain evictions.
sophia: grep pod admits: `kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath="{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}:{.metadata.annotations.rack-locality}\n" | grep watchdog` shows several watchdog pods with `rack-locality: prefer`.
omar: quick mitigation: flip inventory script to strip `rack-locality` from monitoring charts and add nodeSelector to steer them to `general-purpose` pool. pushing a config change now.
infra-bot: infra-bot: configmap update applied to `monitoring` namespace: removed rack-locality annotation from default template.
dan: after the change, scheduling pressure reduced; two large gang jobs that were pending before now started within ~45s. eviction rate down to baseline.
sophia: follow-ups: 1) infra#834 — audit helm chart defaults for hidden scheduling annotations, 2) autoscaler#492 — add a rule to prefer consolidating small best-effort pods into non-GPU pools, 3) add e2e that creates mix of tiny and large gang pods to catch topology starvation, 4) add alert `gpu_topo_starvation` when gang_pend_time > 30s and tiny_pod_density_on_gpu_nodes > 0.6.
omar: also propose a soft quota on number of best-effort pods per GPU node to avoid thundering of tiny sidecars.
dan: cc support for impacted customers in the 02:15 UTC window. thanks team. :thumbsup:\n
